newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices mostly steady, October higher.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices mostly steady, October higher.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) was said to be holding steady again Friday although October prices were discussed higher, industry sources said.
"These higher (natural) gas prices are helping to push October (power) higher," said one ERCOT marketer.
Weekend and Monday prices were being talked steady with virtually no spot business being done due to mild weather in much of the state, the sources said.
"We've offered it at various prices but no one seems interested," said one seller, who added that he had not heard of any spot trade today.
On-peak ERCOT power for weekend and Monday delivery of a 16 hour block was talked steady in the $19.60-20.60 range, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak next-day power was pegged steady in the $13.25-14.00 range, the sources said.
October on-peak ERCOT power was pegged higher in the $18.50-19.50 area from $17.75-18.75 discussion on Thursday, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
